purpose: vyadhimuktake (!) (likely corrupt for vyādhimuktaye, for relief from disease)
notes: The catalogue records 'Harikṛṣṇa jośī' as donor and 'somavāra' as weekday, neither of which appears in the quoted colophon text (the colophon gives 'vāreṃśumālinaḥ', i.e., Ravivāra / Sunday, and no donor is mentioned).
